title: i love a fun time musical!!!!!! #mysticpizza #mysticpizzamusical #pap...
transcript: Left DC at 8:00am this morning cause we are here for the matinee of Mystic Pizza at Paper Mill Playhouse. I'm so excited. Paper Mill always does such cool stuff. Like, the set is incredible. Like, I love how detailed it is. So cute. And the show features all hits from like the 80s and 90s. And you know how much I love a jukebox musical. I'm very excited and I love this cast. I'm so excited, but especially Tiana and F. Look at that. All I know is they get married, which is hilarious and perfect and amazing for me. Jeremy, what are you most excited about? Um, I'm most excited for the music, but I'm going in completely blind because I love 80s and 90s music, but I don't wanna know what they're playing so we're not spoiling for Jeremy. Feel like I'm gonna have to order pizza for dinner now because it looks so good. Anyway, Mystic Pizza opens tonight! I'm so excited to be here, and I will see you at intermission with my intermission thoughts. Also the pre show playlist. 1,000 out of 10 recommend.
